title: Lightly Grilled Mediterranean Lamb Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy post-workout dish featuring marjoram and Mediterranean friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Sprinkle the chopped marjoram and shaved bonito flakes over the lamb skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional marjoram if desired.
